sop_modules.name: Trim Paint Setup
sop_modules.description: Prepare work area for NC trim painting. Protect floors, verify masking, clean surfaces.

tasks.name: Protect Floors
tasks.description: Lay paper or plastic floor protection in work areas. Tape seams for spray.

tasks.name: Verify Masking
tasks.description: Verify all masking is sealed. Check tape edges, film coverage, corners.
tasks.notes: Binary task - masking is either complete or it is not

tasks.name: Wipe Down Trim Surfaces
tasks.description: Remove construction dust and debris from trim surfaces before painting.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Protect floors → Verify masking → Wipe surfaces

sop_modules.name: Trim Initial Prep
sop_modules.description: Primary fill-sand-caulk cycle for NC trim. This is the HEAVY LIFT where majority of prep work occurs. Addresses fastener holes (2 stacked every 12-16"), gaps at joints/walls, open grain at board ends.

required_inputs.notes: For open grain fill calculation: 2 ends per door opening SIDE. Counted per side: interior door = 2 sides, exterior door = 1 interior side.
For open grain fill calculation: 4 ends per window opening

tasks.name: Fill Fastener Holes
tasks.description: Fill nail/brad holes with lightweight spackle. Standard density: 2 stacked holes every 12-16 inches. Overfill slightly for sand-back method.

quality_notes.QT3: Fill obvious holes; small pinholes may be left
quality_notes.QT5: Fill every hole, no matter how small

tasks.name: Fill Open Grain at Casing Ends
tasks.description: Apply putty or caulk to open grain at exposed casing end cuts. Typical locations: door header casing ends (2 per door opening), window header and sill casing ends (4 per window opening). Wipe smooth with damp finger or rag. Note: Cope cuts and miter joints on running trim are handled during normal caulk/fill tasks.

quantity_calculation.notes: Door: 2 exposed ends on header casing per opening SIDE (interior door = 2 sides, exterior door = 1 interior side). Window: 2 ends on header casing + 2 ends on sill casing.

tasks.name: Sand Filled Areas
tasks.description: Sand spackle and filler smooth. Feather edges. Use 150-180 grit.

quality_notes.QT3: Knock down ridges; flush not required

tasks.name: Full Surface Sand
tasks.description: Scuff sand entire trim surface for adhesion. 180-220 grit.

quality_notes.QT5: Thorough sand 220+ grit, uniform scratch pattern

tasks.name: Remove Sanding Dust
tasks.description: Vacuum and tack wipe all trim surfaces. No dust before caulking or coating.

tasks.name: Caulk Baseboard Joints
tasks.description: Caulk baseboard top edge to wall. Single caulk line along top, fewer miters than casing. Smooth with wet finger. NC consumption: ~72 LF per tube. Applied after sanding/cleaning to keep caulk dust-free.

tasks.name: Caulk Door/Window Casing Joints
tasks.description: Caulk casing on both inside and outside edges to wall, plus miter joints. More time-intensive than baseboard due to double-sided caulking and more miters per LF. Smooth with wet finger. Applied after sanding/cleaning to keep caulk dust-free.

quality_notes.QT4: Smooth caulk lines on both edges
quality_notes.QT5: Perfect tooled caulk, invisible joints on both edges

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Fill holes → Fill open grain → Sand filled → Full sand → Clean dust → Caulk baseboard → Caulk casing

sop_modules.name: Apply First Finish Coat
sop_modules.description: Apply first finish coat to prepared trim. First coat reveals hidden defects.

tasks.name: Spray First Finish Coat
tasks.description: Apply first finish coat via airless or HVLP spray. Modified urethane enamel typical.

quality_notes.QT5: Slow controlled application, optimal mil per PDS

tasks.name: Brush First Finish Coat
tasks.description: Apply first finish coat via brush. Quality angle brush, proper loading technique.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Single application task - spray OR brush based on application_method

sop_modules.name: Interstage Process
sop_modules.description: Maintenance cycle between finish coats. Lighter than Initial Prep. Addresses issues revealed by first coat.
sop_modules.run_rule: Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat

tasks.name: Clean Work Area
tasks.description: Clean floors, remove overspray accumulation, dust, debris.

quality_notes.QT5: Meticulous clean, floors, flat surfaces, windowsills

tasks.name: Inspect Coat
tasks.description: Visual inspection for dust nibs, missed holes revealed by first coat, coverage issues. Mark defects for repair.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick glance, address obvious issues only
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan at 3 feet, identify dust nibs, missed areas
quality_notes.QT5: Lighted critical inspection at arm's length, zero tolerance

tasks.name: Light Sand Between Coats
tasks.description: Scuff sand surface for adhesion. 220 grit. Knock down dust nibs.

quality_notes.QT3: Spot sand only - visible nibs and rough spots
quality_notes.QT4: Light full sand - entire surface scuffed
quality_notes.QT5: Thorough full sand 220-320 grit - uniformly smooth

tasks.name: Patch Revealed Defects
tasks.description: Walk trim and fill holes, dents, damage revealed by first coat.

quality_notes.QT4: Repair all marked defects visible at 3 feet
quality_notes.QT5: Repair all defects regardless of size

tasks.name: Sand Patches
tasks.description: Walk trim and feather patched areas smooth. 150-180 grit.

quality_notes.QT4: Proper feather, no visible edges at 3 feet

tasks.name: Spot Coat Patches
tasks.description: Walk trim and brush-apply finish over patched areas to seal before next coat.

quality_notes.QT4: Required - all patches get spot coat
quality_notes.QT5: Required, may need multiple passes for full seal

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Clean → Inspect → Light sand → Patch → Sand patches → Spot coat patches

sop_modules.name: Apply Second Finish Coat
sop_modules.description: Apply second (final) finish coat for full hide and durability.

tasks.name: Spray Second Finish Coat
tasks.description: Apply second finish coat. Final appearance coat.

tasks.name: Brush Second Finish Coat
tasks.description: Apply second finish coat via brush.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Single application task after interstage complete

sop_modules.name: Final Inspection and Cleanup
sop_modules.description: Final quality inspection and job cleanup.

tasks.name: Final Quality Inspection
tasks.description: Walk all trim, inspect per tier scrutiny level.

quality_notes.QT5: Lighted critical inspection at arm's length

tasks.name: Final Touch-Up
tasks.description: Address any final defects found during inspection. Walk trim and touch up as needed.

tasks.name: Remove Protection
tasks.description: Remove floor protection and masking materials.

tasks.name: Clean Tools
tasks.description: Clean brushes, spray equipment, dispose of consumables. Occurs twice per shift per crew member.
tasks.notes: Heuristic time block: 15 minutes per occurrence, 2x per shift per crew member. Example: 2-person crew working 1 shift = 4 occurrences = 60 minutes total.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Final inspection → Touch-up → Remove protection → Clean tools

phase_sequence.interstage_run_rule: MOD_TRIM_NC_INTERSTAGE runs after Finish Coat 1 (before Coat 2). Does NOT run after final coat.
